newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Hold the birthday cake, Bhutto tells supporters.
newsitem.headline: Hold the birthday cake, Bhutto tells supporters.

text.p: Opposition leader Benazir Bhutto, beset by personal and political trouble in recent months, has asked her Pakistan People's Party (PPP) not to celebrate her birthday, a PPP spokesman said on Friday.
"Bhutto has appealed to PPP workers not to celebrate her birthday," the spokesman said.
Bhutto, 44 on Saturday, has had an unhappy year.
Her brother Murtaza Bhutto was shot dead by police in Karachi on September 20 last year.

President Farooq Leghari, a former PPP stalwart, sacked her as prime minister on November 5 on disputed charges of corruption and misrule. That led to national and provincial elections on February 3, in which the PPP was routed.
Bhutto's husband Asif Ali Zardari has been in jail since her dismissal on suspicion of involvement in Murtaza's killing and several corruption cases. He denies the charges.
